t: This is Whipps Cross University Hospital, a large hospital in Leytonstone, in the London Borough of Waltham Forest. It is managed by Barts Health NHS Trust. The most famous person born here is David Beckham, the footballer, who won nineteen major trophies and is the only English player to win a league title in four different countries. The DJ and producer Andrew Weatherall died here in 2020. He moved from the acid house scene of the late 1980s to remixing artists such as New Order, Björk and Primal Scream. The photographer Harry Diamond, known for his pictures of artists, jazz musicians and the East End, also died here.
